evidence: Thicknesses of the films were obtained by fitting the reflectance spectra measured using a Hitachi U2000 spectrophotometer. Crystallinity and crystallite orientations were determined in a Philips MPD 1880 X-ray diffractometer using Cu K a radiation. Surface morphology and uniformity of the Gd2O3 and Er2O3 films were analysed by Nanoscope III (Digital Instruments) atomic force microscope (AFM). Time-of-flight elastic recoil and detection analyses (TOFERDA) were performed at the Accelerator Laboratory of the University of Helsinki in order to determine the elemental concentrations and stoichiometry of the Nd2O3, Sm2O3, Gd2O3 and Er2O3 films. Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR) was used to obtain information of the stability of the films against atmospheric moisture and CO2. In order to characterize electrical properties of the as-deposited films, 100 nm thick aluminium contacts were e-beam evaporated onto the Ln2O3 surface and backside of the Si(100) substrates. Capacitance–voltage (C–V) and current–voltage (I–V) measurements were carried out on the resulting Al/Ln2O3/native SiO2/n-Si(100)/Al structures using a HP 4284A precision LCR-meter and Keitley 2400 Source Meter, respectively.
